offers.title: AI Engineer
offers.description:
About the role

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to join our research team in Berlin. You will design and deploy large-scale LLM-based systems, work with Python and PyTorch, and collaborate with world-class researchers.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in ML/AI engineering
  • Strong Python skills
  • Experience with LLMs, transformers or generative models
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices

offers.title: ML Engineer (Remote)
offers.description:
Who we are

Scalar AI is a remote-first startup building the next generation of ML infrastructure. We need a sharp ML Engineer to own model training pipelines, experiment tracking and production deployments.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain scalable ML training pipelines
  • Deploy models to production with low latency requirements
  • Integrate LLM-based features into core product

Requirements

  • Python, PyTorch or JAX
  • Experience with experiment tracking (MLflow, W&B)
  • Comfort with Docker and CI/CD

offers.body: Barcelona Data Labs is building the data backbone for the next wave of AI products. We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong Python skills, experience with Spark or dbt, and a good understanding of data modelling. Hybrid position in Barcelona (3 days office, 2 remote). Spanish and English required.

RemoteStack is a 100% distributed team building cloud-native ML platforms. We need an MLOps Engineer to own our model deployment stack: Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub Actions, and model serving with FastAPI or Triton. Full remote from Spain. 2+ years experience required.
